testsuite.name: com.crush.mobile.domain.file.LineDifferTest

testcase.name: two empty bodies are not a change
adjacent edits share one hunk instead of shredding
a trailing newline is not an edit
distant edits produce separate hunks
reordering lines is reported as removals and additions
context lines are numbered and every line either side of a change is present
a large file with a small edit still diffs properly
a one-line change yields one hunk with context
an identical body is unchanged
an added line is ADDED and its text is the new one
line counts are reported even when the file is unchanged
a large changed region is labelled, not silently approximated
an empty line is preserved rather than dropped
a whole-file rewrite is not labelled too large when within the cap
a brand new file is entirely added
changed lines carry their own 1-based numbers
the hunk header is the first line shown, context included
the stat matches the hunk counts
a deleted file is entirely removed
duplicated lines still yield the minimal edit script
